description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_Dxy_periodic (the mixed second derivative d^2u/dx dy) driven by problems/anisotropic_diffusion_2d_periodic.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of NX=NY together (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The bare cross operator is symmetric indefinite (eigenvalues -N^2..+N^2) and would blow up under time integration, so the MMS embeds it in a positive-definite anisotropic diffusion tensor K=[[1,1/2],[1/2,1]]: the combined operator D(D(u,x),x)+D(D(u,x),y)+D(D(u,y),y) (central_D2x_periodic + central_Dxy_periodic + central_D2y_periodic) is negative definite and dissipative. The manufactured steady solution sin(2 pi x) sin(2 pi y) is held by the exactly matching analytic forcing (derivation in the problem file); the drift at t=0.1 is the pure O(h^2) truncation of the anisotropic operator, whose cross-derivative half is the rule under test, so a bug in central_Dxy_periodic corrupts the recorded L2/Linf errors and the order.
